about: Per-part syllabus tags for AA HL. Each part was tagged by two independent blind reviewers against data/syllabus.json and data/syllabus-aa-hl.json; parts where they disagreed were settled by an adjudicator (review: adjudicated, with rationale and both original tag sets). HL appearances of SL questions (data/shared.json) take the SL tags and are not listed here.

parts.label: a(i)
parts.skill: Sketch a cubic for a given parameter, labelling the y-intercept and turning points found with the GDC
parts.rationale: The marks are for a correctly shaped cubic with its intercept and turning points labelled, read from the GDC before f' is introduced in (b), so it is a degree-3 polynomial graph (2.12) with max/min found from technology (2.4) rather than calculus (5.8).

parts.label: a(ii)
parts.skill: Sketch a cubic for a second parameter value, labelling the y-intercept and turning points found with the GDC
parts.rationale: Same mark structure as a(i) for a second parameter value: shape and intercept of a cubic graph plus GDC-located turning points, with no derivative work yet required.

parts.label: b
parts.skill: Differentiate a cubic containing a parameter

parts.label: c(i)
parts.skill: Parameter value giving a stationary point of inflexion

parts.label: c(ii)
parts.skill: Parameter values for which f'(x)=0 has two roots, giving a max and a min

parts.label: c(iii)
parts.skill: Parameter values for which there are no stationary points
parts.rationale: The single mark is for stating the parameter range where f'(x)=0 has no solutions; the method mark for analysing the quadratic derivative sits in c(ii), so only the stationary-point reasoning (5.8) is assessed here.

parts.label: d(i)
parts.skill: Locate stationary x-values and evaluate the maximum y-coordinate in terms of the parameter
parts.rationale: Marks come from solving f'(x)=0 for the stationary x-values (5.8) and then simplifying f(-sqrt c) using rational indices to reach the c^(3/2) form, which is the 1.7 boundary for rational exponents.

parts.label: d(ii)

parts.label: e(ii)

parts.rationale: The reasoning mark is for interpreting the limiting value of the sequence as n grows as the polygon tending to a circle of radius 2, which is limit-by-convergence reasoning (5.12); the l'Hopital/Maclaurin computation belongs to e(i) and circle facts are prior learning.

parts.label: f(ii)
